Round194H.native_weight_translation (u v s x t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
  nativeWeight u v s (x + t) ≤ translationCost u v s t * nativeWeight u v s x
'Round194H.native_weight_translation' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
Round194H.native_dual_weight_translation (u v s x t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
  1 / nativeWeight u v s (x - t) ≤ translationCost u v s t / nativeWeight u v s x
'Round194H.native_dual_weight_translation' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
Round194H.native_dual_translation_integral (u v s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hc : Continuous f)
  (hf : Integrable (fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2 / nativeWeight u v s x) volume) :
  Integrable (fun x => ‖f (x + t)‖ ^ 2 / nativeWeight u v s x) volume ∧
    ∫ (x : ℝ), ‖f (x + t)‖ ^ 2 / nativeWeight u v s x ≤
      translationCost u v s t * ∫ (x : ℝ), ‖f x‖ ^ 2 / nativeWeight u v s x
'Round194H.native_dual_translation_integral' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
